title: Cleanroom Gowning, Airlocks & PPE: Imperatives & Must
description: Essential English for sterile gowning procedures, airlock entry steps, and mandatory cleanroom hygiene rules.
learning_objectives: Give and follow clear cleanroom gowning instructions
Use modal 'must' and 'do not' for GxP hygiene protocols
Avoid Czech mother-tongue errors with basic modal verbs

questions.prompt: Always _____ your hands with sterile disinfectant before entering Grade B airlock.

explanations.correct: Imperative instruction uses the base form 'wash'.
explanations.wrong_A: '-ing' cannot be used for direct commands.
explanations.wrong_C: Third person '-es' cannot form an imperative.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Vždy si umyjte ruce'. In English, direct instructions use base verb: 'Always wash'.

questions.prompt: All personnel _____ wear sterile nitrile gloves in the cleanroom suite.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is followed directly by the bare infinitive ('must wear').
explanations.wrong_A: Never use 'to' after 'must' (*must to wear* is a frequent Czenglish error).
explanations.wrong_B: 'have wear' is ungrammatical; it would need 'have to wear'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Never say *must to wear*. Modal 'must' takes the bare verb without 'to': 'must wear'.

questions.prompt: Do not _____ both airlock doors at the same time!

explanations.correct: Negative imperative 'Do not' requires the base verb 'open'.
explanations.wrong_A: Third person '-s' is invalid after 'Do not'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Neotvírejte obě dveře současně'. Use 'Do not open'.

questions.prompt: The technician _____ the differential pressure gauge on the wall every two hours.

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'The technician' requires singular '-s' in Present Simple ('checks').
explanations.wrong_D: Participle alone cannot be the main verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Technik kontroluje'. Third person singular in English requires '-s': 'checks'.

questions.prompt: Where _____ the sterile shoe cover dispenser located?

explanations.wrong_C: 'does' is not used with passive adjective 'located'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Kde se nachází dávkovač návleků?'. Singular subject $ightarrow$ 'Where is the dispenser...?'.

questions.prompt: You _____ touch sterile vial stoppers with bare hands under any circumstances!

explanations.wrong_B: 'Don't have to' means it is optional (nemusíte), which is a critical hygiene hazard!
explanations.wrong_D: 'Needn't' means lack of necessity, not strict prohibition.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Nesmíte' = 'must not'. Do not confuse with 'nemusíte' ('don't have to').

questions.prompt: The cleanroom autoclave _____ a digital data logger for temperature records.

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'The autoclave' takes 'has' for possession.
explanations.wrong_B: Stative 'have' does not take continuous aspect.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Autokláv má'. Singular subject takes 'has', not 'have'.

questions.prompt: Please _____ the yellow emergency stop button if the conveyor jams.

explanations.correct: Polite imperative takes base form 'press' after 'Please'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Prosím stiskněte...'. In English: 'Please press the button'.

questions.prompt: Differential pressure between Grade B and Grade C _____ currently 15 Pascals.

explanations.wrong_B: 'have' cannot link to a measurement predicate.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Tlakový rozdíl je...'. 'Pressure' is singular $ightarrow$ 'is 15 Pascals'.

questions.prompt: Operators _____ not enter the filling suite without complete sterile gowning.

explanations.correct: 'May not' (or 'must not') expresses formal regulatory prohibition in GMP SOPs.
explanations.wrong_A: 'do not enter' would require bare imperative syntax.
explanations.wrong_D: 'can not' expresses lack of physical ability rather than formal regulatory prohibition.

questions.cz_learning_point: In pharmaceutical GMP standards, 'nesmí vstoupit' is formally rendered as 'may not enter' or 'must not enter'.
